newsitem.title: FRANCE: McCann Erikson wins worldwide Strepsils campaign.
newsitem.headline: McCann Erikson wins worldwide Strepsils campaign.

text.p: McCann Erickson Paris said on Friday its parent, U.S. advertising agency McCann Erikson Worldwide, had won the worldwide advertising campaign for throat lozenges Strepsils which was previously run by DDB Worldwide.
McCann Erikson Worldwide is a unit of Interpublic Group of Cos Inc.
The advertising budget for Strepsils, which are made by Britain's Boots Healthcare, should be 160 million francs in 1997 across all 110 countries where the product is sold, the statement said.

Strepsils becomes the second Boots product to be handled by McCann-Erikson, the agency added. It already handles advertising of painkiller Nurofen, sales of which grew 30 percent worldwide in 1996, it said.
